name: Fortinet FortiGate
author: Netlens
description: Reads a FortiGate firewall (FortiOS 6.4+, REST API with a read-only token): the firewall as the gateway node with its interfaces, the devices behind it (DHCP leases, FortiGate device identification, ARP) with name, vendor, operating system and type, and its health: high availability, VPN tunnels, firmware and licence expiry. Read-only: only GET requests.

info.title: Set up the FortiGate (once)
info.text: Create an administrator profile that can only read (System, Network and VPN read, nothing else), then a REST API administrator with that profile and a token, and trust only the machine that runs Netlens. In the web interface: System > Admin Profiles, then System > Administrators > Create New > REST API Admin. The token is shown once. Or in the CLI (change the address; the token is printed once):
info.code:
config system accprofile
  edit netlens-ro
    set secfabgrp read
    set netgrp read
    set sysgrp read
    set vpngrp read
    set utmgrp none
  next
end
config system api-user
  edit netlens
    set accprofile netlens-ro
    set vdom root
    config trusthost
      edit 1
        set ipv4-trusthost 192.168.0.10 255.255.255.255
      next
    end
  next
end
execute api-user generate-key netlens

config.label: FortiGates
config.help: One line per firewall (list both units of a high-availability pair only if you want both; the cluster answers on one address). A firewall with several VDOMs: one line per VDOM.

columns.label: Role
columns.help: auto: the first firewall is the gateway of the network, any other one is shown as a node below it.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Untick it only when the firewall uses its factory certificate and you cannot install your own. The token travels in every request.
